identity.name: SIMAN-G
identity.description: A professional, data-centric platform for managing state assets with precision and clarity. The design prioritizes data density, readability, and rapid information retrieval.

primary.name: State Blue
primary.description: Deep, authoritative blue for primary actions and headers.

secondary.name: Asset Gold
secondary.description: Used sparingly for high-priority alerts or key conversion points.

rules: No gradients on backgrounds. Use solid, matte colors.
Text contrast must be WCAG AA compliant (4.5:1 minimum).
Use 'State Blue' for primary buttons and active states.
Use 'Asset Gold' only for critical notifications or 'Premium' asset tags.

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-all

inputs.style: bg-white border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:border-transparent rounded-md h-10

navigation.sidebar: bg-slate-900 text-slate-300 w-64 fixed h-full border-r border-slate-800

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on dashboard backgrounds to reduce sterility.
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for dropdowns, shadow-md for modals. Avoid large diffuse shadows.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only on sticky table headers and toast notifications (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80).

login_background.description: Modern government building facade, conveying stability and authority.

asset_real_estate.description: Independence Palace, representing high-value state property.

asset_machinery.description: Yellow excavator, representing construction and heavy machinery assets.

dashboard_abstract.description: Abstract blue geometric shapes for widget backgrounds or banners.

motion.hover_effects: Subtle lift (-1px) and border darkening for interactive cards.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings (ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-slate-900) on all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Control Room' grid layout for the main dashboard.
Use the provided image URLs for the login page and asset placeholders.
Customize Shadcn components to match the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' archetype (square corners, high contrast borders).
Ensure all data tables support sorting, filtering, and pagination.
Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for all body text and data cells.
Do NOT use gradients for backgrounds; stick to solid colors and subtle textures.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
